method: Run from the worktree root in this order. First, transplant: for each firm, the minting pin's holdings_snapshot.py and publication.py (full detached worktrees outside the repository, sparse checkout disabled there alone) were taken and the five exemption commits b1f767053e, 1b184295b6, 738bf3d07f, 1ad921000c and 381be2ca6c were applied in that order, each as a three-way merge against its own parent blob, with the one-date bypass lines dropped from the single conflict per firm; the transplanted files were written to the deliverables folder, committed, and checked (ABSENT-AT-SOURCE blocks stripped and diffed against the pin). Second, the firm phase ran once per firm in its own process: the committed transplant files were copied into the pin tree, the firm bundle was built twice by the minting pin safe_deploy_core build_bundle_payload (arm A and arm B, no upload function called), the live bundle was read with s3api head-object and get-object (read only) and compared member by member with the candidate, and five offline test files were copied from the overlay pin and run with pytest on the transplant tree (the one-date bypass test was not run). Third, the assemble phase wrote the record. Nothing was uploaded, minted, deployed, signed or written to AWS.
notes: Facts and their basis: the overlay pin fa2502c5b1 is the base of the IB-pr-590 candidate; the five exemption commits b1f767053e, 1b184295b6, 738bf3d07f, 1ad921000c and 381be2ca6c are the ones that touch the two files and are authored by workers 419, 420 and 424, and the chain is linear for both files (each parent blob equals the previous commit's blob).

Transplant conflicts: the only conflict is the 1ad921000c hunk in run_firm beside the one-date bypass; its bypass lines are context in the commit and are dropped, the exemption call-site lines are kept. The pin text outside the exemption blocks is kept. No hunk of 15e0361375, de08782c38 or 5fad7eaaa8 is applied; the 49F CUSIP port stays live in the 49F pin.

Not read and not run: no Lambda was invoked, no publish or mint function was called, no sign-in was made and no vendor was contacted. The live object version was compared with the IB-pr-549 mint record as a boolean only; the version identifier is not written. test_holdings_bypass_one_date.py was not run because it tests the bypass that is not shipped.

Sparse directories: the base worktree's sparse set gained data/assets/scripts/gold/investor_reporting/ only (local, never committed); the three pin worktrees are full detached checkouts outside the repository, so the import-chain directories were not needed there. The transplant commit's gates printed a WARN that the client-data account-id list is absent on this box, so that commit was not checked against it; its six files carry code only.
